component.name: V4L2 Passthru
component.summary: Low-latency V4L2 video and audio passthrough viewer

description.p: V4L2 Passthru is a low-latency Qt6/QML and GStreamer desktop passthrough viewer for USB V4L2/UVC video capture devices and their accompanying USB audio inputs on Linux.

Play and stream game consoles, cameras, or other external video sources directly on your PC with minimal buffering while keeping a persistent Wayland/X11 window and named PipeWire/PulseAudio stream for screen sharing or broadcasting.

ul.li: Direct YUYV 4:2:2 and MJPG video capture up to 1080p60 via v4l2src
Low-latency PipeWire/PulseAudio audio passthrough with live mute and volume
Automatic stall watchdog and USB reset recovery without closing the window
Auto-hiding HUD controls during active playback
